verification.instructions: 1. Build an OpenFHE CryptoContext with the parameters in contextSpec above. 2. Deserialize public_key.bin into a PublicKey<DCRTPoly>. 3. Deserialize secret_key.bin into a PrivateKey<DCRTPoly>. 4. Deserialize ciphertext.bin into a Ciphertext<DCRTPoly>. 5. Decrypt with the secret key. 6. Call GetPackedValue() on the resulting plaintext. 7. The first 8 slots must equal plaintext.values; remaining slots are zero up to the context's slot count.
